description: This Java source file defines the MonkeyPowerEvent class, which handles power measurement events for the Android Monkey testing tool. It manages logging power test events, buffering them, and writing logs to a file.

classes.name: MonkeyPowerEvent
classes.description: A class representing power measurement events in the Android Monkey testing framework, capable of buffering and logging power-related events.

methods.name: MonkeyPowerEvent
methods.description: Constructors for creating MonkeyPowerEvent instances with optional power log tag and test result.

methods.name: bufferLogEvent
methods.description: Buffers a power event with a timestamp, tag, and optional value for later logging.

methods.name: writeLogEvents
methods.description: Writes all buffered log events to a log file on the SD card.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the power event, either buffering a new event or writing logs to file.
